newsitem.title: USA: A.O. Smith to buy back up to 3 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: A.O. Smith to buy back up to 3 mln shares.

text.p: A.O. Smith Corp said Tuesday its board of directors authorized the repurchase of up to three million shares of its outstanding common stock.
The repurchase includes both its common stock, traded on the New York Stock exchange, and its class A common stock, traded on the American Stock Exchange.
The company said it intends to repurchase shares periodically and hold them in treasury for general corporate purposes.
A.O. Smith has outstanding 15 million shares of common stock and 5.8 million shares of class A common stock.
On Monday, A.O. Smith said it reached a definitive agreement to sell its Automotive Products unit to Tower Automotive Inc for approximately $625 million.
